observer: LD_PRELOAD process constructor/destructor; timings differ from headline benchmark boundary

findings.volatile: Observed frequency regime changes, approximately 4.6 GHz to 800 MHz, explain roughly 5.7x CPU-time changes on identical native programs. Slow bodies consume CPU rather than wait. State-size threshold is confounded by this policy; no fixed pipe timeout was observed.
findings.persistent: Every Commit rewrites MAGIC + 64-byte environment identity + four u64 fields (message,state,response limits and state length) + canonical state + SHA256; fsync temporary, rename, fsync directory. No separate response/registry/idempotency metadata; application receipts are in canonical state.
findings.perf: Denied by perf_event_paranoid=4; no system settings changed.
findings.after: Post-fix sampled call windows contain zero fsync calls. Headline data are separate untraced, non-preloaded harness runs on committed code f2c174c.
findings.mutators: Untraced native worker CPU medians: indexed 2.086 ms above 4 GHz (n=57) versus 11.848 ms below 900 MHz (n=74); voucher issue 2.296 ms (n=40) versus 13.015 ms (n=28). Wall times closely follow CPU time, with zero median major faults and voluntary switches. This directly confirms frequency dependence for both broad distributions.
findings.scaling: Traced fast-frequency prepared-worker CPU medians grow from 2.438 ms at 100 rows to 17.745 ms at 1000 and 19.136 ms at 1105. The near-flat original wall-time curve is confounded by the 100-row slow-frequency regime, not evidence of constant-time state processing.

observer_source_note: Before samples used the initial equivalent observer retained under .build/paper-bench/worker-clock.c; final paper/bench/worker-clock.c adds input/output error guards and readable formatting.

import sys, json, os, statistics
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from paper.bench.run import BUILD,session,source,package,metadata
from tools.client import prepared_frame
result={'metadata':metadata(),'records':[]}
for count,persistent in [(10,False),(100,False),(10,True)]:
 name=f'diag-{count}-{persistent}'; folder=package(BUILD/name,'read',count)
 code,proof,universal=source(folder)
 with session(folder,name,persistent=persistent,timing=True) as s:
  handle,_=s.prepare(code,universal)
  os.write(2,f'DIAG START {name} pid={s.p.pid}\n'.encode())
  rows=[]
  for i in range(31):
   row=s.call(code,proof,['read',f'k{count-1:06d}'],dict(status='success',value=0),handle=handle)
   rows.append(row)
  os.write(2,f'DIAG END {name}\n'.encode())
 result['records'].append(dict(rows=count,persistent=persistent,samples=rows[1:]))
 print(name,statistics.median(x['elapsed_ns']/1e6 for x in rows[1:]),flush=True)
 (BUILD/'diagnose-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

untraced_mutators.runner_source:
import sys,json,os,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from paper.bench.run import BUILD,metadata,package,source,session,operation
result=dict(metadata=metadata(),diagnostic=True,observer='Untraced LD_PRELOAD process CPU/wall/frequency; separate from headline samples',observer_sha256=hashlib.sha256((BUILD/'worker-clock.so').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),records=[])
for kind in ['indexed','voucher']:
 name='diagnose-untraced-'+kind;folder=package(BUILD/name,kind)
 clocks=BUILD/(name+'.clocks.jsonl');clocks.unlink(missing_ok=True)
 os.environ.update(LD_PRELOAD=str(BUILD/'worker-clock.so'),JAYDB_WORKER_CLOCK=str(clocks))
 code,proof,universal=source(folder)
 with session(folder,name,timing=True) as s:
  handle,_=s.prepare(code,universal)
  rows=[]
  for i in range(301):
   args,value=operation(kind,i)
   row=s.call(code,proof,args,dict(status='success',value=value),handle=handle)
   if kind=='voucher':s.call(code,proof,['retire',f'r{i:04d}'],dict(status='success',value='retired'),handle=handle)
   if i==0:offset=clocks.stat().st_size
   else:rows.append(row)
 result['records'].append(dict(program=kind,persistent=False,samples=rows,native_clocks=[json.loads(line) for line in clocks.read_bytes()[offset:].decode().splitlines()]))
 (BUILD/'diagnosis-untraced-mutators.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(kind,'complete',flush=True)
